subject: general
question: What is ‘Adi Vaani’, whose Beta Version the government is set to launch?

options.text: India’s first AI-powered translator for tribal languages
A national scholarship scheme for tribal students
A digital archive for tribal folk arts
A community radio network for remote tribal regions

solution:
The correct answer is __**India’s first AI-powered translator for tribal languages.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Ministry of Tribal Affairs announced the upcoming Beta launch of Adi Vaani__, billed as __India’s first AI-powered translator for tribal languages__, to advance inclusive tribal empowerment and preserve the country’s rich linguistic diversity.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Adi Vaani__ is an AI-powered translation tool focused on __tribal languages__, launching in Beta.**
 
• **Developed under __Janjatiya Gaurav Varsh__ to bridge communication between __tribal and non-tribal__ communities.**
 
• **Combines advanced AI to __protect and promote tribal culture__ and linguistic heritage across India.**
 
• **Strengthens India’s __constitutional values of cultural diversity__ and positions the nation as a leader in AI-driven language preservation.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Ministry of Tribal Affairs**__

 __
 
• The Ministry highlights Adi Vaani as a step toward inclusive tribal empowerment__ and linguistic preservation.
 
 
 
• __**Janjatiya Gaurav Varsh**__
 __
 
• The framework under which Adi Vaani is developed to bridge communication gaps__ and celebrate tribal heritage.
 
 
 
• __**Cultural Diversity & Constitutional Values**__
 __
 
• The initiative reinforces India’s commitment to cultural diversity__ and recognition of __endangered languages__ as part of national heritage.
 
 
 
• __**AI-Driven Language Preservation**__
 __
 
• Adi Vaani aims to make India a global leader__ in using AI to __preserve and promote__ tribal languages and culture.
